def summarize(rows, isNew=False):
		#The selected rates may be all the same or different. If they are the same we populate the fields, if not they're left blank (mixed)
		def same(key, default=None):
			values = [row[key] for row in rows]
			return values[0] if len(set(values)) == 1 else default
		tools = [row['toolingAssetId'] for row in rows]
		return {
					'isNew': isNew,
					'itemAssetRateIds': [] if isNew else [row['itemAssetRateId'] for row in rows],
					'assetId': same('assetId'),
					'itemId': same('itemId'),
					'toolingAssetId': same('toolingAssetId'),
					'toolingName': (same('toolingName', 'Mixed')) if any(tools) else None,
					'standardRate': None if isNew else same('standardRate'),
					'scheduleRate': None if isNew else same('scheduleRate'),
					'itemPeriodId': same('itemPeriodId'),
					'packageCount': same('packageCount', 1.0),
					'infeedUnitId': same('infeedUnitId'),
					'outfeedUnitId': same('outfeedUnitId'),
					'wasteUnitId': same('wasteUnitId'),
					'enabled': True if isNew else same('assetRateEnabled'),
					'itemSourceId': same('itemSourceId')
				}

	ctx = value['ctx']
	if ctx['single'] and ctx['usesTooling'] and value['tool'] is not None:
		#One machine and item: edit the rate for the picked tool (0: the machine's own rate), or start a new one from the machine's rate
		toolId = value['tool'] or None
		rows = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getAssetItems({'assetId': ctx['assetId'], 'itemId': ctx['itemId'], 'includeTooling': True}))
		match = [row for row in rows if row['toolingAssetId'] == toolId]
		if match: return summarize(match)
		base = [row for row in rows if row['toolingAssetId'] is None] or rows
		info = summarize(base[:1], True)
		info['toolingAssetId'] = toolId
		info['toolingName'] = None
		return info

	try:
		ids = list(value['values']['itemAssetRateIds'] or [])
	except:
		ids = []
	if ids:
		return summarize(system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getAssetItems({'itemAssetRateIdList': ids, 'includeTooling': True})))
	return {'isNew': False, 'itemAssetRateIds': [], 'assetId': None, 'itemId': None, 'toolingAssetId': None, 'toolingName': None,
			'standardRate': None, 'scheduleRate': None, 'wasteUnitId': None, 'infeedUnitId': None, 'packageCount': 1.0,
			'itemPeriodId': None, 'outfeedUnitId': None, 'enabled': False, 'itemSourceId': None}
return [{'value': row['itemUnitId'], 'label':row['itemUnitName']} for row in system.kanoa.item.getItemUnits({'enabled': True})]

if not (value['single'] and value['usesTooling']): return []
	rated = dict((row['toolingAssetId'], row['toolingName']) for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(
		system.kanoa.item.getAssetItems({'assetId': value['assetId'], 'itemId': value['itemId'], 'includeTooling': True})) if row['toolingAssetId'])
	tools = [(row['toolingAssetId'], row['assetName']) for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(
		system.kanoa.tooling.getTools({'mountableOn': value['assetId'], 'enabled': True}))]
	tools += [(toolId, name) for toolId, name in rated.items() if toolId not in [t[0] for t in tools]]
	options = [{'value': 0, 'label': "None (the machine's own rate)"}]
	for toolId, name in sorted(tools, key=lambda t: t[1]):
		options.append({'value': toolId, 'label': name + (' (has a rate)' if toolId in rated else '')})
	return options

if value['toolingAssetId'] is None or value['assetId'] is None or value['itemId'] is None: return ''
	cycles = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.tooling.getCycleRates({'assetId': value['assetId'], 'toolingAssetId': value['toolingAssetId'], 'enabled': True}))
	#Positions set to this item, or to no item (they make whatever item is running); blocked ones count toward the standard
	parts = sum(row['standardPartsPerCycle'] or 0 for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.tooling.getPartsPerCycle({'toolingAssetId': value['toolingAssetId']}))
				if row['itemId'] in (value['itemId'], None))
	if not cycles:
		return "This tool has no cycle rate on this machine, so without a rate here the machine's own rate for the item is used."
	if not parts:
		return "None of this tool's positions makes this item (all are set to other items), so without a rate here the machine's own rate for the item is used."
	cycle = cycles[0]
	#Parts are outfeed units; the machine's own rate for the item converts them to its infeed units (none means 1)
	own = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getAssetItems({'assetId': value['assetId'], 'itemId': value['itemId']}))
	packageCount = (own[0]['packageCount'] if own else None) or 1
	fmt = lambda v: system.kanoa.utilities.formatNumber('#,##0.###', v)
	how = '%s cycles x %s parts per cycle' % (fmt(cycle['cycleRate']), fmt(parts))
	if packageCount != 1:
		how += ' x %s package count' % fmt(packageCount)
	return "Without a rate here, the tool's cycle rate gives %s/%s (%s). This rate replaces that for this item." % (
		fmt(float(cycle['cycleRate']) * parts * packageCount), cycle['itemPeriodName'], how)
return value['tool'] if value['single'] and value['usesTooling'] else None
return value or "None (the machine's own rate)"

customMethods.name: save
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('save() called')
	
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	info = self.view.custom.info
	
	#We have turned on the ability for the user to create a new unit, if they do this, the value in the value.infeedUnitId will likely be a string
	#If we detect a string, then we will add this to the units table
	infeedUnitId = info.infeedUnitId
	outfeedUnitId = info.outfeedUnitId
	wasteUnitId = info.wasteUnitId
	
	added = {}
	unitsFailed = []
	def unitId(value):
		#A unit typed into the dropdown: add it, once per name (the same new unit can be in infeed, outfeed and waste). addItemUnit returns (itemUnitId, msg)
		if type(value) not in (type(''), type(u'')): return value
		if value not in added:
			itemUnitId, msg = system.kanoa.item.addItemUnit(value, userId)
			added[value] = itemUnitId
			if itemUnitId is None: unitsFailed.append('"%s": %s' % (value, msg))
		return added[value]
	units = [unitId(value) for value in (infeedUnitId, outfeedUnitId, wasteUnitId)]
	if unitsFailed:
		#One toast for every unit that couldn't be added (868mvvzbz)
		self.toast({'type': 'error', 'message': "Couldn't add unit%s %s" % ('' if len(unitsFailed) == 1 else 's', '; '.join(unitsFailed))})
		return
	infeedUnitId, outfeedUnitId, wasteUnitId = units

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.units")	#If we added any units, we'll refresh the dropdown options
	
	if info.isNew:
		self.addToolRate(userId, infeedUnitId, outfeedUnitId, wasteUnitId)
		return

	data = system.kanoa.item.getAssetItems({'itemAssetRateIdList': list(info.itemAssetRateIds), 'includeTooling': True})
	
	#If the user has not selected a value for a field, we will use the value that was previously stored for this item
	saved = 0
	failed = 0
	for row in data:
		itemAssetRateId = row['itemAssetRateId']
		itemId = row['itemId']
		assetId = row['assetId']
		rateInfo = {
						'itemAssetRateId': row['itemAssetRateId'],
						'itemId': row['itemId'],
						'assetId': row['assetId'],
						'standardRate': info.standardRate or row['standardRate'],
						'scheduleRate': info.scheduleRate or row['scheduleRate'],
						'itemPeriodId': info.itemPeriodId or row['itemPeriodId'],
						'infeedUnitId': infeedUnitId or row['infeedUnitId'],
						'outfeedUnitId': outfeedUnitId or row['outfeedUnitId'],
						'wasteUnitId': wasteUnitId or row['wasteUnitId'],
						'packageCount': info.packageCount or row['packageCount'],
						'enabled': info.enabled,
						'itemSourceId': info.itemSourceId or row['itemSourceId']
					}

		#Rows updated; None (logged) or a license message when it failed
		result = system.kanoa.item.updateItemAssetRate(rateInfo, userId)
		if result is None or isinstance(result, basestring): failed += 1
		else: saved += 1
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshItems", {})
	#One toast for the save. The editor stays open, so the success toast has an id: saving again while it shows doesn't stack another
	if failed:
		self.toast({'type': 'error' if not saved else 'warning', 'autoClose': 0,
			'message': "Couldn't save %d of %d rates: see the gateway log" % (failed, failed + saved)})
	else:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'item-rates-saved', 'type': 'success', 'message': 'Saved %d rate%s' % (saved, '' if saved == 1 else 's')})
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.info")	#update the info values with any changes to the units

	return

customMethods.name: addToolRate
customMethods.script:
info = self.view.custom.info
	if info.toolingAssetId is None:
		self.toast({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Pick the tool this rate is for'})
		return
	if not info.standardRate:
		self.toast({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Enter a standard rate'})
		return
	rateInfo = {
					'assetId': info.assetId,
					'itemId': info.itemId,
					'toolingAssetId': info.toolingAssetId,
					'standardRate': info.standardRate,
					'scheduleRate': info.scheduleRate or info.standardRate,
					'itemPeriodId': info.itemPeriodId,
					'infeedUnitId': infeedUnitId,
					'outfeedUnitId': outfeedUnitId,
					'wasteUnitId': wasteUnitId,
					'packageCount': info.packageCount or 1,
					'enabled': info.enabled,
					'itemSourceId': info.itemSourceId
				}
	result = system.kanoa.item.addItemAssetRate(rateInfo, userId)
	if not result:
		self.toast({'type': 'error', 'message': "Couldn't add the tool rate. The machine must use tooling and the tool can't belong to another site; see the gateway log."})
		return
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshItems", {})
	self.toast({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Tool rate added'})
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.info")	#now editing the new rate
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.toolOptions")
	return

customMethods.name: toast
customMethods.script:
'''One toast at a time on this view. The first one's id is kept; every later toast updates it while it's showing, and shows it again under
	the same id once it has closed (a show with the id of a toast still showing is ignored, so the two never stack) (868mvvzbz).'''
	params = dict(params)
	toastId = self.view.custom.toastId
	if toastId:
		params['id'] = toastId
		system.kanoa.toast.update(params)
		system.kanoa.toast.show(params)
	else:
		self.view.custom.toastId = system.kanoa.toast.show(params)
